The '''Ut'ttailri Jawa Camp''' was a mobile settlement of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], centered around a [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]]. However, the sandcrawler was damaged in the [[Northern Jundland Wastes]], stranding the tribe there. [[Tteek Tlek]] was one of the Jawas living at the camp.<ref name="TOR:LOftLG" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> it was visited by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eriz Vossan]] in his [[Dark Plague]]-induced madness. Vossan instructed the Jawas to dismantle their [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] and use the parts to build [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]] to fight the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] instead.<ref name="TOR:LOftLG" />
